title: Holiday gridlock looms as P150-M overhaul of Bukidnon bridge set

blocks.text: MALAYBALAY CITY, Bukidnon — Motorists and cargo haulers traversing Sayre Highway, Mindanao’s primary inland artery, brace for massive holiday gridlock as major retrofitting work on the structurally compromised Atugan Bridge in Barangay La Fortuna, Impasugong, Bukidnon, is set to roll out in December—right at the height of the Christmas travel rush. Shara Vinessa Garcia, spokesperson for the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Bukidnon 1st District Engineering Office, confirmed to the Inquirer on Friday, November 13, that the procurement process has officially commenced for the P150-million emergency rehabilitation project.
